neighbours.label: accessing or finding information (find information, read online, access information, write down questions)
fire: Patients can now access information about their results anytime through the portal.
If you have questions, ask your nurse where you can find more information.
Customers increasingly prefer to read reviews online before they buy a car.
Our library helps students find reliable information for their essays.
Visitors can look up opening hours and maps online before they arrive.
Parents are encouraged to read the school newsletter online each week.
The new app lets members access information on classes from their phones.
Write down your questions before the visit so you can find answers quickly.
quiet: Patients can now park their cars anytime in the new garage by the clinic.
If you feel dizzy, ask your nurse for a chair and a glass of water.
Customers increasingly prefer to pay with cards when they buy a car.
Our library helps students relax with comfortable chairs and quiet rooms.
Visitors can walk through the gardens and the old chapel when they arrive.
Parents are encouraged to pack a healthy lunch for their children each day.
The new gym lets members bring a friend to classes on Fridays.
Bring a warm coat to the visit because the waiting room is cold.

notes: Top tokens ' information' x6, ' online' x5, ' read' x3, ' find'; examples are patient/customer info-access contexts.
